items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 6:05 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Prohibited Dog Designation Appeal - Presswood, COR-2026-354
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 6:10 p.m. and reconvened at 6:36 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic, with all members present. Councillor A. Owodunni was participating virtually.

items.title: Potential Land Disposition Matter (Land Disposition - Section 239 (2) (c))
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for September 14, 2026
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 6:38 p.m.

motions.item_title: Prohibited Dog Designation Appeal - Presswood, COR-2026-354
motions.text: "That Council ratify and confirm the decision of the Dog Designation Appeal Committee respecting the appeal filed by S. Presswood, wherein the Committee upheld the Prohibited Dog Designation applied to the dog ‘Tig’ by the Humane Society of Kitchener-Waterloo and Stratford Perth, as outlined in Corporate Services Department Report COR-2026-354."
motions.text_html: "That Council ratify and confirm the decision of the Dog Designation Appeal Committee respecting the appeal filed by S. Presswood, wherein the Committee upheld the Prohibited Dog Designation applied to the dog ‘Tig’ by the Humane Society of Kitchener-Waterloo and Stratford Perth, as outlined in Corporate Services Department Report COR-2026-354."

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a land disposition matter and a land acquisition and solicitor client privilege matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
motions.text_html: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a land disposition matter and a land acquisition and solicitor client privilege matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) and (f) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.item_title: Potential Land Disposition Matter (Land Disposition - Section 239 (2) (c))
motions.text: “That the Chief Administrative Officer be authorized to negotiate the sale of the Subject Property set out in the Development Services report DSD-2026-353, which is surplus to the City, based on the terms and conditions discussed at the September 14, 2026, in-camera meeting of Council; and further, That the Chief Administrative Officer be authorized to execute the necessary documentation to effect the transaction and agreements, and that said documentation be to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor”
